boundaries: The original product§5.2:145 requires reviewed business templates and reauthorization of new enterprise/material inputs. Original non-JSON form, mandatory targets and stage/result separation are respected by the selected limited surface.

There is no complete ordinary template consumer path in this baseline. TemplateConsumer requires exact isolated fixture DB/org, TemplateEngine requires active isolated config/repository/permits and current source/head, ParkInstanceConsumer requires exact isolated catalog. configured_app does not attach these consumer routes; CURRENT/provider mutual exclusion remains.

A useful and independently testable current slice is original page input/current pinned catalog binding, old-consumer stage reuse and scoped readonly original-key recovery. Positive evidence belongs to original already-reviewed SYNTHETIC candidate fixture, separately from ordinary missing-source refusal.

An ordinary missing-route/source response must be shown accurately as unavailable/refused. It cannot turn into empty-catalog success or a fallback to arbitrary consumer/old successful Case. Do not add a formal source loader/framework or disable old admission to obtain a UI positive.

New GET recovery must compare exact actor/key/park/org/database and reconstructed flat CONSUME fp from immutable input, not accept another-action request row or client hash as proof. Key lookup stays actor-scoped; a missing own key must not scan/disclose another actor key.

The readonly recovery and legacy consumer.read availability are distinct from resume/adoption reconciliation which can write. No consume/resume/persist is permitted during the new GET. Current authorization/refusal cannot falsify prior unknown commit.

Optional catalog pin omission preserves old request identity; explicit null fails. The directory-source pin and reviewed-template source/release are distinct authorities. Neither implies the other or a physical cross-database atomic commit.
No formal browser/Windows/real model/thirdscope/P1-P5 run or previously accepted matrix is required to implement/test this bounded slice. The old HTTP ReadTimeout cause remains UNKNOWN.
